title: trigger.entity names an event; the write path is in no API mapping
provenance: v2 rewrite of the committed CRE-R-24 plan's trigger (POST /api/review/advance, entity TaskPublished) over the reconstructed TaskPublished contracts. The request body {taskId, tenantId} is the review.advance request, not the event. This plan is the base the S04/S08/S09 seeds extend.

requirement.text: WHEN the final (4th) review step of a Task is approved via review.advance, the create service SHALL publish a TaskPublished event with source bawp.create to the create-evb bus, and the get-ready service SHALL make the published Task available through getTasks.

plan.title: approving the final review step publishes TaskPublished and get-ready lists the task

setup.description: a Task whose review steps 1-3 are approved, leaving step 4 pending

propagation.waitFor: the TaskPublished event to reach get-ready via the create-evb bus
